name: @exattime/awe-agent
description: The AWE Governed Agent Execution Plane: versioned agent definitions, the Capability Registry that separates business permission from raw tool access, the Action Proposal contract a planner must speak, the authorizer that turns a proposal into an immutable Policy Decision Record, approval binding to exact arguments, the execution budget, the governed harness state machine, and the evaluation and candidate-promotion boundary. Pure and provider-neutral; depends only on @exattime/awe-kernel and @exattime/awe-control-plane.
